paite: Josiah alal pat tung in kum giat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat alal a; anu min Jedidah, Boskath a Adaiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Josiah / (2 Kro 34.1,2)

paite: Ama'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, apu David lampi tot tengteng atawn a, taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam apialkhe kei hi.
Kumpipa Josiah alal kum sawm-le-giatna kum in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Meshullam tapa Azaliah tapa laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah,
heading: Dan Laibu Muhkhiakna / (2 Kro 34.8-28)

paite: "Siampu lianpen Hilkiah kiang ah hohtou inla, kongkhak veng mite'n mite a pan ana lakkhawm uh TOUPA' inn a dangka kikoih sim uhenla;
TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite pia uhen; amau inn se bawl TOUPA' inn a nasemte pia uhen.
Singlem bawl mite, inn lam mite, inn sia bawl mite'n inn siatna tak bawlna sing leh suangsek aleitheihna ding un, chi in va gen in, chi in TOUPA' inn ah asawl hi.
Himahleh dangka apiakte uh etpih nawn ding in agelhsak tuan kei, muanhuaitak a hih zel ahih ziak un," achi hi.
Siampu lianpen Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah dan laibu ka mu,” achi hi. Hilkiah in huai laibu Shaphan apia a, ama'n asimta hi.
Kumpipa kiang ah laigelhmi Shaphan ava hoh a, kumpipa kiang ah thu ava tun nawn a, "Na mite'n inn a dangka omte apekhe vek ua, TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite ape vek uh," achi hi.
Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, huchi in Shaphan in kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
Kumpipa'n dan laibu a thute azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuante abotkek hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah tapa Akbor, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asahiah kiang ah,

"Kei, mi tengteng leh Judah teng a ding in hiai laibu a thu tuang toh kisai in TOUPA hon dotsak un. I pi-le-pute'n hiai laibu a thute zuih ding ana ngaihkhiak louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.

Huchi in siampu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan, Asahiah, puansilh kempa Harhas tapa Tikvah tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ahoh ua, ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem sehkhen nihna a teng ahi.
Ama'n akiang uah TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in hichi in achi, “Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh un," TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
"Ngai in, hiai mun ah leh asung a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, Judah kumpipa'n laibu a, athusim tengteng bang in.
Kei ahon paisan ua, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, akhutsuak ua ahon thangpaihsak ziak un hiai mun ah ka thangpaihna nakpitak in akuang dia, amawkmih kei ding hi.
Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah huchi in na chi ding uh. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,

hiai mun leh asung a tengte hihgam leh hamsiat in a-om ding uh chih thu ka gen na zak a, na lungtang anem a, TOUPA ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puante na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in, ke'n leng na thu ka na za, TOUPA'N achi.

Huchi in ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah ka hon pi dia, na han ah lungmuangtak a pi in na om dia, hiai mun a thil hoih lou ka tunsak ding tengteng na mit in amu vek kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai thu kumpipa kiang ah atun nawn uhi.
